project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
Detected directly writing or similar in 'http.ResponseWriter.write()'. This bypasses HTML escaping that prevents cross-site scripting vulnerabilities. Instead, use the 'html/template' package and render data using 'template.Execute()'.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): internal/serve/serve.go:53 writes the go:embed'ed static index.html read at line 47; compile-time constant content with no request input, and the server is hard-coded loopback-only at line 84, so the XSS pattern the rule targets cannot occur

mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
47 | 		b, err := assets.ReadFile("assets/index.html")
   48 | 		if err != nil {
   49 | 			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
   50 | 			return
   51 | 		}
   52 | 		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
   53 | 		w.Write(b) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort body write on a broken pipe
   54 | 	})
   55 | 	return mux
   56 | }
   57 | 
   58 | // ensureMetrics recomputes a stale metrics cache under the artefact lock
   59 | // (serve-task-1 D5: precomputed at serve start, never per-request).
